risk.recommendation: Proceed with enhanced due diligence on the listed points before the Credit Committee.

findings.title: Leverage above risk appetite
findings.policy_query: leverage debt to equity ratio exceed 3.0 guarantees
findings.action: Require additional guarantees or reduce the exposure.
findings.policy_excerpt: The debt-to-equity ratio (total liabilities / equity) should not exceed 3.0. Above 3.0 the file requires additional guarantees or a reduced exposure.

findings.title: Working capital pressure
findings.policy_query: liquidity current ratio below 1.0 working capital
findings.policy_excerpt: The current ratio (current assets / current liabilities) should be at least 1.0. A ratio below 1.0 indicates working capital pressure.

findings.title: Weak debt service capacity
findings.policy_query: debt service coverage ratio EBITDA annual debt service 1.5
findings.action: Strengthen guarantees or restructure the repayment schedule.
findings.policy_excerpt: The debt service coverage ratio (EBITDA / annual debt service) should be at least 1.5. Between 1.0 and 1.5 the file is acceptable only with strong guarantees. Below 1.0 the request is outside risk appetite.

findings.title: Medium inherent-risk sector
findings.evidence: Sector: Freight forwarding and warehousing (Tanger Med zone).
findings.policy_query: sector inherent risk real estate trading logistics classification
findings.policy_excerpt: Real estate development, general import/export trading, money exchange, precious metals and cash-intensive businesses are classified as high inherent-risk sectors. Logistics and construction are medium. Agriculture, manufacturing with audited accounts, and regulated professions are low.

findings.title: Incomplete KYC / credit file
findings.policy_query: identification legal entities statutes commercial register missing documents cannot be approved
findings.action: Request the missing documents before any decision.
findings.policy_excerpt: Every corporate customer must provide its statutes, a recent extract of the commercial register (modèle J), its ICE number, and the identity documents (CNIE or passport) of every director and legal representative. Files missing any of these documents cannot be approved.

findings.title: Rapid pass-through of funds
findings.evidence: 1 international inflow(s) totalling 1,500,000 MAD were sent out (>= 90%) within 3 days.
findings.policy_query: pass-through incoming international transfer followed within 3 days outgoing 90% layering
findings.action: Obtain invoices and contracts linking inflows and outflows.
findings.policy_excerpt: An incoming international transfer followed within 3 days by outgoing transfers of 90% or more of the amount, with no apparent economic link, is a pass-through indicator often associated with layering.

findings.title: Flows with high-risk jurisdictions
findings.policy_query: transfers high-risk jurisdictions FATF high-secrecy country risk list counterparty contract invoice
findings.action: Enhanced review of counterparties and underlying contracts.
findings.policy_excerpt: Transfers to or from jurisdictions subject to a FATF call for action, or listed as high-secrecy jurisdictions in the bank's country risk list, require enhanced review of the counterparty and the underlying contract or invoice.
